_comment: Golden contract for src/core/url.cjs::canonicalizeUrl – the stored key the re-submission short-circuit looks up (issue #28). Canonicalization drops what does not change which page a link points at: scheme, default ports, case, duplicated and trailing slashes, fragments, tracking parameters, and query order. It keeps everything that does. The fingerprint cases of the n8n build are gone with `opportunityFingerprint`: reject deletes the row, so cross-source identity has no consumer.
